paper_ref: An, Ang, Bali, and Cakici, NBER Working Paper No. 19590, October 2013
economic_intuition: Increases in call implied volatility proxy for bullish option-market information and predict higher next-month stock returns.
detailed_definition: Monthly change in call implied volatility.

required_fields.concept: Underlying stock return used for next-month portfolio returns.
required_fields.source_detail: The paper obtains underlying stock return data from CRSP.

required_fields.source_detail: The paper denotes end-of-month annualized call implied volatility as CVOL.
